lines.vo: Just checking your progress can push you closer to your goal.
Jay logs today's habits in his Daily Habit Builder.
One review pooled a hundred thirty eight experiments, with nearly twenty thousand people.
lines.cap: One review pooled 138 experiments, with nearly 20,000 people.

lines.vo: People nudged to monitor their progress were more likely to reach their goals.
And the boost was bigger when progress was written down, or shared.
So don't just set the goal. Check it, every day.
Log it, check the box, see the streak. That's how you stay on track.

hook: Tracking your goal makes you *more* likely to hit it
